title: Cuttlepack
description: Vanilla-friendly expressivity maxxing tech pack for chill SMP
body:
An opinionated collection of tech mods with a view to making a fun multiplayer experience that allows for creation of complex machines without being a bloated mess or introducing things that make vanilla progress feel obsolete or pointless (so vanilla players can coexist with high-tech players in a friendly SMP). 

i.e. 'Bunch of tech mods for fun and QoL'.

Notable tech mods include ComputerCraft, XNet, Create and Project Red Fabrication (build IC circuits with logic gates that accept bundled redstone input).

Notable fun mods include Proximity Voice Chat, Custom emotes and paintings and custom instruments that accept user uploads (3D animation, image files, MIDI files).



(Please note that this is in beta so included mods may change rapidly)
